Hello to everyone,

I’m so glad I found this forum, it’s such a great idea. Thank you in advance for your precious time. 

I’m a bit rusty on lavaan, and I am not sure how to implement a model I have in mind. 

I conducted a latent profile analysis in R/MPlus on the Big Five. I'd like then to import the profiles in lavaan to conduct an exploratory regularised mediation as in this paper here (https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/10705511.2017.1311775). The lavaan syntax of the approach is reported at the end. 

The thing is…I have no idea how to enter (personality) latent profiles as predictors in a mediation model in lavaan. Do you have any resource to share on the topic or R script I could play around with? I searched on the internet but I could not find any. 

Wish you all a nice day, 

Livia

messages.subject: Re: Latent Profiles as predictors in Lavaan
parts: I conducted a latent profile analysis in R/MPlus on the Big Five. I'd like then to import the profiles in lavaan to conduct an exploratory regularised mediation

Like factor scores, those are just estimates, based on estimated model parameters.  You would need some way to account for their uncertainty.  Perhaps there is a way to obtain plausible values of latent profiles from Mplus, as they provide plausible values of factor scores and latent classes.  

https://www.statmodel.com/download/Plausible.pdf

Then you could use multiple-imputation techniques, as shown on the ?semTools::plausibleValues help page.
